sources.title: BlockFusion wins approval to reopen bitcoin mine on Frontier Avenue

profile.campus_note: One of 11 buildings OpenStreetMap contributors have mapped under this name in this locality, numbered west to east.
profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: local press names the operating entity "Northeast Data LLC" doing business as BlockFusion. All 10 OSM nodes for this name sit within ~250m of each other on the same Frontier Avenue industrial site and resolve to the same address via Nominatim reverse geocode; treated as one multi-building campus, not 10 distinct facilities.

reading.body:
BlockFusion Niagara Falls occupies a consolidated industrial campus on Frontier Avenue where multiple buildings operate under a single entity. The facility's specifications and published power capacity are not included in the available data. Without megawatt figures, the campus cannot be assessed for AI hosting density or scaling potential relative to other installations.

New York has 31 mapped data center facilities, but only one publishes a power capacity specification. BlockFusion Niagara Falls ranks second among published facilities in the state, meaning it would account for some portion of New York's 3 MW of disclosed capacity if its own figure were disclosed. The state's low published capacity total and the rarity of disclosed specifications suggest most facilities here operate without public technical documentation.

The available sources identify this campus as a bitcoin mining operation that has recently won regulatory approval to restart. No certifications, IT load specifications, or power delivery details are published. The transition from cryptocurrency mining to AI workloads, the campus's actual power allocation, and its readiness for training or inference compute remain undocumented.
